about.en: XVS is the governance token of Venus Protocol, a decentralized money market for lending and borrowing crypto assets that launched on BNB Smart Chain and also runs on Ethereum, Arbitrum, opBNB and other networks. XVS was issued on BNB Smart Chain at 0xcf6bb5389c92bdda8a3747ddb454cb7a64626c63, with Venus-operated cross-chain deployments elsewhere.
